title: Cabinet extension manifest
description: Every extension (channel adapter, source adapter, skill, MCP) ships this manifest as manifest.yml|.yaml|.json at its directory root — validated by cabinet/scripts/validate-extension.sh (axes spec 2026-07-05 §6.4). Extensions RECEIVE resolved axis values from their loader; they never read axis config themselves — the axis linter runs over the extension's files with an EMPTY allowlist. Loaders skip manifest-invalid extensions fail-closed and file a need.

action_types.description: The action_type strings this extension emits (classifier vocabulary where applicable; may be empty for pure sources/skills).

risk_classes.description: The authority-matrix risk classes those action_types map to — closed vocabulary (framework.authority.matrix.RISK_CLASSES; drift-pinned by test_axes_contract.py).

undo_contract.description: none = no pseudo-undo exists, so this extension's action_types can never be act-first-eligible in ANY posture (inverse-required rule); delete_window(N) = artifacts deletable for N seconds after send.

axis_compat.description: Axis values this extension supports; ABSENT = compatible with all (the default). Consumed by loaders only — never read by the extension itself.

entrypoints.description: capability -> file path relative to the extension dir; each must realpath-resolve INSIDE the extension dir (traversal/symlink escapes are refused) and exist.

sunset.description: OPTIONAL lifecycle bound — an ISO date (e.g. '2026-10-05') or a condition string (e.g. 'undefined +90d review'). Read by the apoptosis reaper, which cards the extension for removal-wave review once the date passes / the condition holds. ABSENT = no scheduled sunset (the default; nothing is reaped).
